rules.statement: A WRITE_METADATA operation MUST NOT alter the executable semantics of the file. The normalized AST (excluding docstrings and line numbers) MUST be identical before and after the mutation.
WRITE_METADATA actions MAY insert comment lines into source files.
WRITE_METADATA actions MAY replace existing comment lines.
A new or replacement comment line written by a WRITE_METADATA operation MUST NOT exceed 120 characters.
WRITE_METADATA actions MAY remove comment lines from source files.
WRITE_METADATA actions MAY insert docstrings into classes, functions, and modules. Docstrings are declarative metadata that do not alter executable semantics.
WRITE_METADATA actions MAY replace existing docstrings for correction and enrichment without altering executable code.
WRITE_METADATA operations are permitted on ALL src/**/*.py files without exclusion lists. The semantic preservation invariant is the sole gate. The .intent/ hard invariant remains inviolable.
